warning.titlePre: Land Rover Defender D300 Known Issues
paragraphs: Defender D300 engines — the Ingenium AJ300D, fitted across the L663 generation — commonly show the Ingenium timing chain pattern over time, along with DC-DC converter failure on the MHEV system. We replace timing chain components, injector seals, bearings, gaskets and the DC-DC converter as standard on every D300 rebuild.
Early production D250/D300 models (2019–2020) also show electrical injector faults — we inspect and replace affected injectors as part of the rebuild where required.
warning.source: Source: verified via specialist buying guide (l663.guide), independently corroborated. P300 (no MHEV system) and Octa (BMW's own 48V hardware) are NOT affected by the DC-DC converter pattern per VRF
